messages:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — NovaRetail POC: they want SAML SSO + SCIM group sync + RBAC mapping. They also want tenant domain locking (only verified domains can create users) and SCIM delta support for low-latency provisioning. Security Q flagged KMS + audit retention. Pricing: curious about hosted vs dedicated. Can we scope blockers?
Jordan: We support SAML (IdP metadata import) and OIDC. For SAML we need their IdP metadata XML and ACS/EntityID. Domain locking is doable via tenant claims but requires domain verification (MX/TXT proof).
Sam: SCIM notes: we expose /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups. Delta (PATCH/If-Match) and bulk endpoints exist but rate-limited. Typical pattern:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"userName":"jane@novaretail.com","emails":[{"value":"jane@novaretail.com"}],"active":true}'

Group->Role mapping example: "groups": ["sales_ops"] -> role: "account_admin". We'll need a mapping table from their HR groups to Redwood roles.
Priya: Security checklist: they asked about KMS/HSM for encryption-at-rest, audit log retention (90/365/industry?). We can offer Private (VPC) / on-prem for EU residency. SOC2 + ISO attestation available. Also need SAML assertion encryption? we support signed assertions and optional encryption.
Elaine: Blockers from sale: 1) legal wants DPA + SCIM provisioning clause 2) cost for high SCIM throughput 3) timeline for domain verification & test accounts. Any estimates?
Sam: Technical blockers: - need test IdP metadata + one admin test account - ask them to whitelist our SCIM IPs if their firewall is strict - if they want SCIM >500 ops/min we need a dedicated rate plan (engineering change). I can enable a temporary higher rate for the POC if we get approval.
Jordan: Pricing rough: Hosted API: usage-based tokens + SCIM per-provision op tier (light). Dedicated: reserved capacity starts at ~monthly commit and includes higher SCIM throughput & private networking — better if they plan bulk provisioning (10k+ users). I'll follow up with pricing sheet.
Legal: Need to confirm whether SCIM provisioning implies creating accounts with PII; if yes we must update DPA + include removal SLA (delete/disable within X days). Also ask for org-level indemnities — typical enterprise ask.
DevBot: Created internal POC ticket POC-4721 and attached a checklist: IdP metadata, sample SCIM CSV, required roles mapping, target user count, expected SCIM ops/min, desired retention. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/POC-4721
Elaine: Action items: Jordan — pricing sheet + dedicated vs hosted ops comparison by EOD tomorrow. Sam — enable temporary SCIM rate bump & share sample mapping file. Priya — draft security Q answers and KMS options. Legal — hit back on DPA language and deletion SLA. I'll sync with customer for IdP metadata and sample CSV. :thumbsup:
Sam: I can mirror a sample mapping CSV, quick preview:
email,groups,redwood_role
jane@novaretail.com,"sales_ops;contractors",account_admin
bob@novaretail.com,"support",support_agent

Sam: FYI — SCIM delta pitfalls we saw: idp uses externalIds not stable -> we recommend matching on email as primary key and storing externalId as metadata. Also provisioning groups which nest can cause duplicates; we'll need clear flattening rules.
Jordan: If they plan to use Dedicated, note that domain locking requires a one-time DNS proof step; expect 1-2 business days for verification if they control DNS. If they can't change DNS, we can support delegated admin claims via SAML attribute but it's less strict.
Elaine: ok thanks — I'll schedule a short call with NovaRetail for Wed to collect metadata and CSV. Marking this thread as single source of truth. Ping me if anything changes.
Priya: Also requested: audit events for SCIM (who, when, what changed). We can expose webhook and event export. Add that to checklist.
Legal: I'll draft the DPA addendum and share redlines by EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
Elaine: perfect — thanks team. Closing loop after Wed call.
